items: Charging Station- The nightstand integrates a charging station with USB ports and power outlets. It offers cable management, keeping your bedroom organized and devices charged efficiently.
Segmented Drawer Organization- The nightstand equipped with 3-drawers, featuring segmented interiors for versatile organization.
Classic style Nightstand- The vintage nightstand boasts metal handles, complementing its classic design.

Solid Paulownia wood—40% lighter than oak, naturally moisture-resistant. Water-based low-VOC finish. Lifetime drawer track support. 365-day returnless resolution. Artisan-crafted, responsibly sourced.

Fully Assembled Convenience – This nightstand comes fully assembled, saving you time and effort. Its integrated structure ensures superior stability and durability, making it a hassle-free and reliable addition to your bedroom.
